Subject: Recap: GDPR discovery + next steps (Clearsight Health)

Hi Emma / Clearsight security team —

Thanks again for taking time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum on the compliance side while sales finishes the commercial items.

Key points from call:
- Clearsight runs both client-facing products and certain managed services — you indicated some data flows where you act as controller and some where you act as processor for downstream clients.
- You asked about Redwood's SOC 2 status, our DPA template, and which EU SCC module is appropriate.
- You asked to kick off a vendor security questionnaire so your risk team can capture evidence.

Proposed immediate actions (please confirm):
1) I circulate a short SOC 2 one-page summary and a draft DPA for your legal team to review.
2) We capture a minimal role mapping (controller vs processor) by dataset so we can pick the correct SCC module — if you can send a short note confirming which of your use-cases are controller vs processor that will help.
3) I’ll share a vendor questionnaire link (or accept yours) and we’ll attach our SOC 2 summary + DPA draft.

Would you like Redwood to propose SCC module language (we typically default to the Controller-to-Processor module for cases where the customer is primary controller) or would you prefer your legal team propose?

Attachments to follow in the next message: SOC 2 summary + DPA draft.

Thanks,
Olga
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
[Attachment stub will be included in the follow-up]

Subject: Re: Recap: GDPR discovery + next steps (Clearsight Health)

Olga —

Thanks for the concise recap. Confirming a couple of things from our side:
- Clearsight will be controller for client-identifiable records we ingest on behalf of our customers, but we also operate a set of analytics pipelines where we act as a processor for third-party data. So for some of the PoCs we discussed you may be processing on behalf of Clearsight (processor role) and for other flows Clearsight will remain controller.
- Please send your SOC 2 Type II summary and the DPA draft. We'll have legal and risk look at the DPA; for SCCs we typically expect the vendor to propose the Controller-to-Processor module when the vendor is acting as subprocessors, but we'll confirm when we map datasets.

We'd like to start the vendor questionnaire this week. Point-person for Clearsight is Emma Larsen (cc'd). Please send the questionnaire link and any supporting artifacts.

Appreciate it —
Security Team
Clearsight Health
